headline: Revenue and profit climb while margin cushion narrows
summary_short: Elopak's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 4.9% y/y to €303.9M with adjusted EBITDA of €45.0M (14.8% margin, -50bps y/y, +100bps q/q); net profit rose to €15.7M from €9.3M y/y and adjusted EPS climbed 87.3% y/y to €0.06.
summary_long: Revenue was €303.9M, +4.9% y/y (+5.7% constant currency). Adjusted EBITDA was €45.0M at a 14.8% margin, down 50bps y/y but up 100bps q/q. Net profit rose to €15.7M from €9.3M y/y. Adjusted EPS was €0.06, up 87.3% y/y from €0.03. H1 operating cash flow was €75M, +39.5% y/y; H1 capex was €43.7M, -4.6% y/y. Net debt was €293M at 2.2x EBITDA leverage.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Within budget (2 WebSearch, 3 fetches), no non-aggregator primary (elopak.com IR / newsweb.no) was fetchable — elopak.com IR routes 404'd or returned no crawlable content. Figures instead corroborated across WebSearch snippets (TradingView/Investegate wire summaries) and one WebFetch of Investing.com's recap of Elopak's Q2 2026 earnings slides (aggregator financial-data portal, not the primary release). Note: resolver's shard kpis.eps_usd carries unit 'NOK' (current) vs 'EUR' (prior periods) — a likely shard labeling inconsistency; all figures here are reported as EUR per corroborating sources and Elopak's EUR reporting currency, and the €0.06 / €0.03 values match the shard's eps_usd.value and prior_yy.value exactly.
